Section 1 of Executive Order 11462 (34 FR 5983, signed 1969-03-28) orders all executive departments, independent establishments and other governmental agencies, including their field services, closed on Monday, March 31, 1969, as a mark of respect for General of the Army Dwight David Eisenhower. The command is tied to that one day and ends with it by the order's own terms. The end is recorded as 1969-03-31, inclusive (the closing runs through that day); the exclusive reading is that it stops when that day begins. Actor: the order itself; the cited source is its own held text, which names the day. No earlier end is shown in held evidence.
